name: Stop Store apps running in the background (Windows 10)
description: Turns off 'Let apps run in the background' for this user.
mechanism: Sets GlobalUserDisabled=1 (HKCU\...\BackgroundAccessApplications) and BackgroundAppGlobalToggle=0 (HKCU\...\Search), the values used by Settings › Privacy › Background apps on Windows 10.
benefit: Store apps no longer wake up to sync or update live tiles, reducing background CPU, RAM and network use.
drawback: Store apps (Mail, Calendar, Phone Link, Weather) won't sync or notify until opened.
evidence: Documented Settings behaviour. Windows 11 replaced the global switch with per-app settings, so this tweak is limited to Windows 10.

name: Policy: deny background execution for Store apps
description: Applies the privacy policy 'Let Windows apps run in the background' = Force Deny for all users.
benefit: Works on Windows 10 and 11; packaged apps cannot run background tasks.
drawback: Affects all users. Notifications and sync of packaged apps (Phone Link, Mail, new Teams, Widgets) may stop until the app is opened. Settings shows 'managed by your organization'.

name: Disable Microsoft Edge Startup Boost
description: Stops Edge from pre-launching at sign-in and staying resident after it is closed.
mechanism: Sets the Edge policy StartupBoostEnabled=0 under HKLM\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Edge.
benefit: Frees RAM (typically 100–300 MB) and removes Edge processes from sign-in.
drawback: Edge opens slightly slower. Edge shows 'Your browser is managed by your organization'.
recommendedFor: PCs where Edge is not the main browser, or with 16 GB RAM or less.

name: Edge: don't keep running after the browser is closed
description: Prevents Edge extensions and apps from running in the background after the last window closes.
mechanism: Sets the Edge policy BackgroundModeEnabled=0 under HKLM\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Edge.
benefit: Edge processes exit when you close the browser, freeing RAM and CPU for games.
drawback: Extensions that run in the background (e.g. some password managers) stop when Edge is closed. Edge shows 'managed by your organization'.
recommendedFor: Gaming PCs that use Edge occasionally.

name: Chrome: don't keep running after the browser is closed
description: Turns off Chrome's 'Continue running background apps when Google Chrome is closed'.
mechanism: Sets the Chrome policy BackgroundModeEnabled=0 under HKLM\SOFTWARE\Policies\Google\Chrome.
benefit: Chrome fully exits when closed, freeing RAM and CPU.
drawback: Background extensions/apps stop when Chrome is closed. Chrome shows 'Managed by your organization'.
recommendedFor: Chrome users who game on the same PC.
